_notes: Normal Arena Tributes are resolved from offer_system Arena Tribute offers whose availability matches an Arena Season.
VIP-Exclusive Tributes are not explicitly listed in arena_config. They are detected from the temporary dragon stat/hatching signature embedded in game_config.
Update tribute_signatures here if Socialpoint changes the values. manual_include/manual_exclude can be used for a temporary correction without changing the extractor.
VIP detection excludes dragons that appear in any known normal Arena Tribute offer, preventing upcoming/current normal Tributes from being retroactively classified as VIP-Exclusive in older seasons.
